Categories: 8 source_absent_in_vault (42999, 47771, 49233, 50113, 52105, 52219, 52299, 59131 — the cited PP28 row is not retrievable from the pinned corpus, 21 lampiran files / 11,208 pages, as hunted), 4 payload_cross_contamination (49296, 52103, 52211, 52232 — the served per_skala payload content belongs to a different activity, conductor eye-verified), 1 mapping_metadata_false (52239 — the recorded pp28_sources pointer is a bizarre cross-sector claim contradicted by the crosswalk). Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py — the false-friend detach pattern: per_skala -> [] + PRESERVE the contaminated block under the disputed key + corroborated _data_note + honest-gap intel_2026.whatYouNeed. NEVER authors a replacement licensing value (rule #9 / rule #4 detach>plausible-remap). pma_status / l4_bali / TKA facets are NOT touched and NOT asserted in any note (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe, plan §8 A-1). Uses the SAME disputed_key as Lot 1 (per_skala_disputed_pp28_collision) for continuity — the key name is generic ('collision'), not flavor-specific, and already spans multiple categories in Lot 1.
